keypoints.description: Explains the four main parts (P, I, D, feed forward) of the Betaflight PID controller and their roles in controlling the quadcopter's movement.
keypoints.strength_reasoning: Dedicated section explaining each element in detail, multiple mentions but not the central focus.
representative_quotes: P is the proportional term of the PID controller.

keypoints.name: Finding Max D Gains
keypoints.description: Describes the process of finding the maximum comfortable D gain for a quadcopter, balancing performance with motor temperature and potential oscillations.
keypoints.strength_reasoning: Introduced as a crucial step, developed with pilot-specific recommendations, and revisited throughout the section, though not consistently reinforced.
representative_quotes: Finding your max D gains that you're comfortable with.
The right D gain is as much as you feel comfortable that you can get away with.

keypoints.name: Finding P to D Balance
keypoints.description: Explains how to find the right balance between P and D gains for a critically damped PID response using PID Toolbox and blackbox logs.

The best way to do this is to look at logs using PID Toolbox.
